trigger.symptom: Two earlier submissions produced no usable runs. All 6 tasks of the first and 3 of 6 of the second failed to start with 'No such image: ... image not found', and both stamped meta.study=adhoc / meta.variant=sweep instead of the study/variant.
trigger.cause: Two independent mistakes. (1) The sweep+experiment YAML were authored under /tmp, and launch_beaker_resumable.py derives meta.study/meta.variant from the studies/<study>/variants/<variant>/ path -- launching from outside that tree silently yields adhoc/sweep, so the runs would not have been attributable to this study. (2) The experiment template was copied from study-01 v2-sc-active, which pins the 2026-06-18 image han-hou/disrnn-wrapper-pck-integration on ai1/octo-hub-onprem-h200; that image is registered in Beaker but the on-prem nodes could not pull it.

evidence.beaker_message: Failed to start job: failed to create container: cannot create container: Error response from daemon: No such image: gcr.io/ai2-beaker-core/public/d8q83ql1t06s73f0bq50:latest: image not found
evidence.second_exp_jobs: 3/6 finalized without starting; both experiments stopped before any training

deviations.cluster_differs_from_study01: ai1/octo-hub-aws-h200 instead of ai1/octo-hub-onprem-h200, because the required image is only verified pullable there. Hardware therefore differs from the study-01 runs this variant bridges to -- which is why the paired timing-OFF arm re-measures the baseline rather than assuming study-01's 0.72729 transfers.
